A severe low-pressure system is currently active over the Bay of Bengal, with weather authorities warning that it is likely to intensify into a full cyclone by tomorrow over the east-central Bay of Bengal. The Indian Meteorological Department has indicated that the storm is expected to make landfall on the 28th of this month around midday, crossing the coastline between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam. ETV conducted an exclusive interview with the Director of the Cyclone Warning Centre, Murthy, to discuss the developments and potential impact of the approaching storm.
